# App Studio Playbook

> Step-by-step journeys for setting up, launching and running an event app with App Studio, from ExpoPlatform. Each journey says what to do, who does it and where it can go wrong, and links to the full App Studio guide for the details.

App Studio Playbook v1.0.0, built from the App Studio guide v1.0.1, checked against App Studio bea65df on 14 Oct 2026.

## Journeys

- [Launch your event app](launch.md): From a new app to people downloading it from the App Store and Google Play.
- [Make the app look like your event](look.md): From your event's brand to an app that shows it, event by event and language by language.
- [Let people sign in and register](sign-in.md): From your app's events to a sign-in screen that lets people in the way your event works.
- [Build the menu and content](menu.md): From each event's menu in App Studio to the features and pages people find in the app.
- [Get people using the app](engage.md): From a widget's switch to the new version that carries it, and from your game's wording to drawing the prize.
- [Change content during the event](live.md): From a change you need during the event to installed apps showing it, with no new version.
- [Release a new version](update.md): From changes that need a new build to people getting the new version, for an app already in the stores.
- [See how people use the app](measure.md): From a live app to numbers you can read, narrow and share.
- [Fix a problem](fix.md): What App Studio's messages mean, and what to do when something does not work.

## Everything in one file

- [All journeys](llms-full.txt): every journey above, one after the other.

## The full guide

- [The App Studio guide](https://ajayexpop.github.io/appbuilder/): every App Studio section, field, message and limit.
